rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; i5329 p. 5, Line 2: "Enter on line 2 the amount that you can exclude. In the space provided, enter the applicable exception number (01–23). If more than one exception applies, enter 99." The reply does not validate: its line 47 references f8889.line13, a line of the per-person Form 8889 collection, without sum_over ("f5329.f5329.l47: collection reference requires sum_over"), so triage/f5329.deepseek.json (executable-triage-v2) executed no line (6 x candidate invalid). This line is ruled by reading its expression against the source. The candidate keeps only the limited exceptions (05, 09, 19, 22 and 23 within their limits, person.x_limited_sum) and drops the exceptions without a fixed limit (person.x_other_exc), so a distribution excepted by, for example, 03 (disability) or 12 (incorrectly coded) is taxed in full. Project stands.

Ruling: model error; f5329 p. 1, line 4, "Additional tax. Enter 10% (0.10) of line 3"; i5329 p. 5, Line 4 (25% for the code S part). The reply does not validate: its line 47 references f8889.line13, a line of the per-person Form 8889 collection, without sum_over ("f5329.f5329.l47: collection reference requires sum_over"), so triage/f5329.deepseek.json (executable-triage-v2) executed no line (6 x candidate invalid). This line is ruled by reading its expression against the source. The candidate enters the sum over the person's Form 5329 of f5329.tax, the total of lines 4 and 49, which reads line 4 itself and adds the HSA excess tax, instead of 10% (25% for code S) of line 3. Project stands.

Ruling: model error; on the validation failure and the reading. i5329 p. 8, Line 47: "Enter the excess of your contributions (made by you or on your behalf) to your HSAs for 2025 from Form 8889, line 2 (unless withdrawn ...), over your contribution limit (Form 8889, line 12). Also include on line 47 any excess contributions your employer made." The reply does not validate: its line 47 references f8889.line13, a line of the per-person Form 8889 collection, without sum_over ("f5329.f5329.l47: collection reference requires sum_over"), so triage/f5329.deepseek.json (executable-triage-v2) executed no line (6 x candidate invalid). This is the failing line; it is also ruled by reading its expression against the source. The candidate copies Form 8889 line 13, the HSA deduction (the smaller of line 2 or line 12), not the excess over the limit. Project stands.

Ruling: representation; f5329 p. 2, line 48, "Total excess contributions. Add lines 46 and 47". The reply does not validate: its line 47 references f8889.line13, a line of the per-person Form 8889 collection, without sum_over ("f5329.f5329.l47: collection reference requires sum_over"), so triage/f5329.deepseek.json (executable-triage-v2) executed no line (6 x candidate invalid). This line is ruled by reading its expression against the source. The candidate sums f8889.excess_amt over the person's Forms 8889, which is exactly the project's line 47 (person.x_hsa_excess, the same sum), and the project's line 48 copies line 47 because lines 42 to 46 are zero in this tool (an earlier-year HSA excess is refused by f8889.unsupported, or by person.x_other without a Form 8889). Same quantity on every return. Project stands.

Ruling: model error; f5329 p. 2, line 49, "Additional tax. Enter 6% (0.06) of the smaller of line 48 or the value of your HSAs on December 31, 2025 (including 2025 contributions made in 2026)". The reply does not validate: its line 47 references f8889.line13, a line of the per-person Form 8889 collection, without sum_over ("f5329.f5329.l47: collection reference requires sum_over"), so triage/f5329.deepseek.json (executable-triage-v2) executed no line (6 x candidate invalid). This line is ruled by reading its expression against the source. The candidate drops the project's guard for a zero line 48, so it needs the year-end HSA value from every person, also with no excess, when the source needs it only to bound a positive line 48 (person.x_hsa_value is asked only then). The values agree whenever the value is supplied. Project stands.

Ruling: model error; i5329 p. 1, Who Must File: "However, if distribution code 1 is correctly shown in box 7 of all your Forms 1099-R and you owe the additional tax on the full amount shown on each Form 1099-R, you don’t have to file Form 5329." The reply does not validate: its line 47 references f8889.line13, a line of the per-person Form 8889 collection, without sum_over ("f5329.f5329.l47: collection reference requires sum_over"), so triage/f5329.deepseek.json (executable-triage-v2) executed no line (6 x candidate invalid). This line is ruled by reading its expression against the source. The candidate says the form is required whenever line 1 or line 48 is above zero, so a filer whose only early distributions are code 1 with the tax owed on the full amount is told to file, and the Schedule 2 line 8 box ("If not required, check here", f1040s2 p. 1) can never be checked. Project stands.
